attention_estimate.basis: Sum of enabled sources' cadence estimates on 2026-11-17: 92.4 posts/month, of which ≈78 is ThinkGeoEnergy's full news wire (≈2.6 items/day; its max_items_per_day of 5 and the briefing's selection budget bound what actually surfaces). The other six enabled sources together add ≈14/month. Five further verified publications are listed disabled (no working feed) and add nothing until an HTML adapter lands.

coverage: Verified pass on 2026-11-17: every main-list site was fetched live, every feed was fetched and its item dates read, and cadences were computed from those dates. The pack covers English-language geothermal trade press, the major industry associations (US, European, global), and company and research-project newsrooms with verifiable publication streams, weighted to North America and Europe. It is NOT a census of the industry: major producing regions whose press is non-English or feed-less (Indonesia, the Philippines, Kenya, Türkiye, Japan) are not covered; no national-lab source passed verification this pass (see 'unverified' for the INL and NREL findings); and companies that communicate only via LinkedIn or wire releases, without an on-site feed or news page, are listed under 'unverified' with the reason rather than silently included.
description: The geothermal industry's own paper trail: the trade-press wire, association policy and market news, and project and company announcements from EGS, closed-loop and conventional developers — every source fetched live and dated on 2026-11-17.
